# CANDIDATE: VOLUME_IMBALANCE_SHORT_TRIGGER

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Volume imbalance (down-bar volume significantly exceeding up-bar volume) precedes sustained bearish moves in 0DTE SPY puts. Adding this as a filter to BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON entries will increase edge_capture by improving win rate on J's winner days without increasing losses on loser days, as the filter rejects low-quality breakdowns prone to failure.

## Mechanism

Trigger: For each 3-min bar, compute down-bar volume (close < open) and up-bar volume (close > open) over the prior 20 bars. If down-bar volume / up-bar volume >= 1.8, trigger fires. Entry logic: BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup only triggers if volume_imbalance_trigger == true AND standard context filters pass (time, structure, ribbon flip, confluence, VIX >= rising/above 20). Exit logic unchanged: chart stop (rejected level + $0.50 buffer), chandelier profit-lock (+5% arm, 0.15 trail), premium stop -50% catastrophe cap, time stop 15:50 ET. Position sizing per risk-rules.md.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap and min 3 contracts.
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest would use 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 SPY 5m data (n≈345 days) with OPRA real-fills simulation. Selection method: all BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON trigger signals filtered by volume_imbalance_trigger. Overfit risk: high if volume threshold optimized in-sample; mitigated by using fixed threshold (1.8) from preliminary analysis.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not yet validated against real OPRA bid/ask/slippage).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 5/04 extreme vol could trigger false signals causing -$500+ loss if volume imbalance fails to predict direction.
   - Max drawdown: potential -$1,200 cascade if filter misses winners and adds losers during regime shift.
   - Blow-up scenario: persistent low-volume downtrends (e.g., summer 2025) cause trigger to never fire, missing all winners while losers still occur via other paths.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (if top-5 days exceed 100% of P&L, state percentage).
